summary: Implemented E3052 (ServiceNetworkConfiguration), E3053 (TaskDefinitionAwsVpc) and E3054 (ServiceFargate) as keyword rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/, with three test modules in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. All 96 tests in the ECS directory plus test_rules_collections.py pass when run with the reference venv and PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src. Changes are uncommitted. Notes: the venv otherwise imports the base checkout's cfnlint; black and ruff are not available in the venv, so formatting was checked by hand (88-column limit). Fixed one bug during testing: E3053 carried a stray NetworkMode path segment, now corrected. One E3052 case (awsvpc task reached only through a non-awsvpc Fn::If branch) is not covered by tests.
